description: Paint a whole part, or the given faces, in one call: paint_open → paint_set_color → paint_part (or paint_faces { keys } from list_faces) → paint_confirm, through the same handlers, so one part is one round trip instead of four. color is #RRGGBB. part_id (an opaque surf id) is made active first when it is not already; omit it for the active part. Colours persist with the assembly (paint_confirm writes the colors map; working copy only, git_save commits). A failure after paint mode opened cancels the session and names the step; the step tools stay for a multi-step session. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

keys.description: Face keys from list_faces to paint; omit to paint the whole part

part_id.description: Part to paint (an opaque surf id from parts). Omit for the active part; another id is made active first, as set_active_part does.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: paint
